انتبهن (form VIII)
# اِنْتَبَهْنَ (intabahna) /in.ta.bah.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
# اُنْتُبِهْنَ (untubihna) /un.tu.bih.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
# اِنْتَبِهْنَ (intabihna) /in.ta.bih.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
